criterion: A hop to a profile that cannot start is refused in the same session, and the running session keeps going.
evidence: cli/hop.go hopModelRefusal refuses before the relay signal is written or the session is TERMed. tests/ccmorph_test.zsh test_a_hop_to_a_profile_that_cannot_pick_a_model_is_refused_in_session_issue_379 (watched red first: the pre-fix run printed 'Switching → strict' and ended the stand-in claude; green after the fix): hop exits non-zero with "not switching to 'strict'" and "This session keeps running.", writes no .reswitch file, TERMs nothing ($HOME/claude-ended absent), prints no 'Switching'. CCMORPH_TEST_FILTER=hop zsh tests/ccmorph_test.zsh: 19 PASS, 0 failures.

criterion: When a hop to a profile with no saved model cannot choose one, the message names the command that lists the models (`ccmorph models strict`) next to the command that saves one.
evidence: The hop refusal reads "no model is set and none can be picked from its model list; list them: ccmorph models strict, then save one: ccmorph set strict model <model-id>" — the zsh test asserts both commands in one message. The adapter's own refusal for the same state carries the same pair: adapter TestAModelMustBeNamedWhenNoListingModelCanBePicked asserts 'ccmorph models demo' next to 'ccmorph set demo model <model-id>' on the EXIT= line (go test ./adapter/ -run TestAModelMustBeNamedWhenNoListingModelCanBePicked: PASS).

criterion: The message uses plain words and does not mention a model protocol or a compatibility check.
evidence: The zsh test asserts the refusal output contains neither 'protocol' nor 'compatibility check'; the Go test asserts the same on the EXIT= line. Both adapter EXIT messages (adapter/adapter.go serve refusal and the 404 listing refusal) were reworded off 'no declared or cached model protocol' and 'the compatibility check may incur a small charge', as was doctor's adapter row; the strengthened TestAModelMustBeNamedWhenTheGatewayOffersNoList and TestAWarmCacheIsNotAModelChoice pin the absence (go test ./adapter/ -run 'TestAModelMustBeNamed|TestAWarmCacheIsNotAModelChoice|TestARefusedListing': all PASS).

criterion: `ccmorph doctor strict` says that a hop will need a saved model, or the hop works without one.
evidence: util/doctor.go adapterLine's INFO row now reads "adapter: this profile needs no translator until a model is chosen, and a hop here will need a saved model (none is set, and none can be picked from the endpoint's model list); …; list them: ccmorph models <name>, then save one: ccmorph set <name> model <model-id>" — pinned by TestAdapterLine's three no-model cases (go test ./util/ -run TestAdapterLine: PASS) and tests/doctor_test.py UNTIL_A_MODEL (94 passed; the only 3 failures are the pre-existing sandbox pty/network ones GH-363's acceptance noted). The other branch holds too: the zsh test's second half hops with no saved model when the listing declares a chat endpoint, and the switch proceeds (exit 0, 'Switching → strict', relay file written).
